result.title: Programmable Semantic Interventions: Learning Causal Carriers from Behavioral Programs
result.summary: Causal abstraction explains a frozen network by aligning its activations with the variables of a simpler, interpretable model, and checking that interventions on the two agree. Finding such an alignment currently requires a counterfactual dataset: for every pair of prompts, the answer the network ought to give once the variable has been changed. In practice, those labels are produced by an executable algorithm for the behavior, written before studying the model supposed to implement it. However, the criterion these methods optimize only leverages the answer an intervention should produce. Here, we develop an approach that lets the investigator define that relationship directly: the answers the variable can produce, and which of them an intervention should yield. We call this interface a semantic program and introduce Programmable Semantic Interventions (PSI): a low-rank activation subspace learned so that interchanging it changes the model's answer as the program declares, with the expected answers read from the frozen model itself. On the MIB benchmark PSI performs on par with supervised alignment at matched data and training budget, without curated pairs, and it needs no ground-truth labels; while on natural science questions with gold labels withheld, it tracks the model's own answers better than a subspace trained on gold labels. The declaration also fixes a coordinate system with known semantics, enabling donor-free steering: jointly training PSI for both localization and control realizes 94.8% of held-out requests for answers the investigator chooses, without the need for donor prompts.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Programmable Semantic Interventions：让研究者用「语义程序」直接声明变量可取答案及干预后应得答案，再据此学习一个低秩激活子空间，使其交换能按声明改变冻结模型的输出；在 MIB 上无需配对数据即可比肩监督对齐，并可实现无需 donor prompt 的引导控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作用「干预应当改变哪个答案」来定位内部状态中的因果载体，可供核查如何验证 LVR 中 latent 推理状态是否真正被答案使用，以及低秩子空间的语义坐标能否用于分离内容与位置等因素；但其对象为纯文本冻结网络与行为程序，尚无视觉或多模态验证。
